scope: Include the original French canonical text and this project’s saved extraction, review, translation and annotation records in the public repository and combined reader.
basis: Project lead authorizes inclusion, citing widespread availability and earlier openly published LARA editions used for several years. The source identifies the original French text as public domain in Australia.
qualification: This records the project lead’s publication decision, not a finding of worldwide public-domain status or a claim of permission from the rights holder. Historical acquisition and annotation metadata remain unchanged.
